title: Supplier
description: Canonical supplier identity, one per distinct INN. Built from organizer supplier relations or from curated external enrichment. No names, regions or roles here (those are SupplierProfile + SupplierEvidence). 'Known' is temporal and computed, never stored: known_at(T) := first_seen_publish_date < T (strict).

supplier_id.description: UUIDv5('supplier:inn:' + inn) — identity is the INN string; KPP never participates.

entity_type.description: Legal form from INN shape only: 10 digits -> legal_entity; 12 digits -> individual_entrepreneur (natural-person INN: IE or other individual); otherwise unknown. Never a market role (HD-09, BR-48).

inn_region_code.description: First two INN digits = tax-registration region evidence (A-115). Not delivery capability, not location of production. Null when INN is malformed.

origin.description: ORGANIZER_DATA if the INN occurs in Поставщики_24-25.csv; EXTERNAL_ENRICHMENT for curated candidates absent from organizer data.

first_seen_publish_date.description: Earliest publish_date among the supplier's SupplierHistory lots (any platform, winner or not). Null for EXTERNAL_ENRICHMENT. Temporal knownness for replay: known_at(T) = first_seen_publish_date < T.
